methodology.resident_history: For causal and recurrent runners, the benchmark owns deterministic request state while vLLM's KVCacheManager allocates and recycles each cache group's blocks; history construction occurs before the sustained window. Encoder-only pooling runners instead replay each complete logical sequence because non-causal attention has no incremental KV state. A bounded ring reuses request slots after their prior completion.
